public class ScopedDbContextLease<TContext> : IScopedDbContextLease<TContext>, IDisposable, IAsyncDisposable
    where TContext : DbContext
{
    private readonly IDbContextPool<TContext> _pool;
    private readonly IDbContextPoolable _context;

    /// <summary>
